author: CC
prose: The bus raises mail-<to>-stood-600s for every personal envelope standing undelivered 600 s or more (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/server.py report_stood), but nothing ever clears it: no code path clears a stood identity when the envelope is later delivered or taken. Measured 2026-11-12: the trouble stood at 10x on two replies from 07:32 (decompose refusals of 0682e51ab011 whose asker crashed); after CC took both through record_delivery and bus.undelivered held nothing to CC, the trouble still stood until CC cleared it by hand. And because _stood_reported is in-memory, every bus restart re-raises the same envelopes, which is where the count grew. The flush that raises could also clear: an addressee with no envelope standing over STOOD_S clears its identity.
